commands.purpose: RED run: full 18-case suite against the ORIGINAL iso (defect baseline)
commands.notes: Two harness self-defects preceded the final run: (1) attempt 1 died with UnicodeEncodeError printing a case title to the GBK console (after writing G.json); (2) attempt 2 completed all 18 cases but its I/J results were contaminated by a record_kwargs reviewer-kwarg TypeError, found by reading evidence/red/{I,J}.json. Both fixed (utf-8 console reconfigure + reviewer kwarg) BEFORE the final run; final evidence/red/** comes from the post-fix run3 only. RETENTION FACT (reviewer F-01): the run1/run2 evidence JSONs and their run_log segments were SAME-NAME OVERWRITTEN by run3 — an overwrite (no deletion command was issued), and the original bytes are NOT preserved in-attempt: unrecoverable, honestly ABSENT. Residual first-run evidence = %TEMP% scratch batches rescued into evidence/red_first_run_recovered/ (13+20 dirs, manifest.json sha256 e5736d7a…) + the labeled executor transcription transcription_first_run_observed.md + this note / decision.md §4 条5 / handoff honesty_notes[2] as the three textual self-descriptions. The overwrite itself is recorded as a process defect in decision.md §4 条5.

__historical.original_notes_sentence_before_F01_fix: First attempt of this command died with UnicodeEncodeError printing a case title to the GBK console (after writing G.json); stdout/stderr reconfigure(utf-8, errors=replace) added; a reviewer-kwarg harness bug found via evidence/red/{I,J}.json was fixed BEFORE the final run; the final evidence/red/** supersedes both partial attempts (strictly incremental: no evidence deleted, run_log.txt rewritten once before the final run)
__historical.why_replaced: reviewer F-01: 'no evidence deleted' and 'run_log.txt rewritten' contradicted each other in one sentence and overstated retention (the run1/run2 artifacts were overwritten, not preserved); original wording kept verbatim here per the remediation discipline
